cards.notes: $95 a year. You choose one of dining or groceries to earn 3x; Tipoff assumes dining, so if you chose groceries these two rates are the wrong way round for you. The choose-one rule is modelled as dining 3x / groceries 1x; Phase 2 makes the choice user-selectable, and until then the user-facing note says which way round the assumption runs. Earn table first confirmed 2026-09-06 via Doctor of Credit (secondary), then re-read on 2026-11-01 from bilt.com/card itself, which closes PLAN §16.14b: the 403 that forced the secondary source is gone, the issuing bank is Column N.A. rather than Cardless, the Bilt dining partner rate is one multiple higher than September recorded, and the Bilt Travel portal rows were missing entirely. bilt.com also states rent and mortgage earn up to 1.25x on a sliding scale rather than the flat 1x the September notes claimed; rent is not a modelled category, so that correction lives in the user-facing note.
